## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 21, 2026 - Aug 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Richard Lawson_, Aug 21, 2026, 1/5: "App is going down hill. I have two ultra twos. I like to charge one and wear one. the data gathering is not synced and doesn't work well between the two watches. Essentially makes the health app worthless. Cardio and fitness tracking is all based on paywall stuff. Not actual workouts that you're doing. I work out 4 hours every week and it tries to say I have less than an hour and 15 minutes a week of working out. The app doesn't work anymore. Pretty typical of tech these days to fail."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _chelsea hinds_, Aug 23, 2026, 1/5: "since the update, the samsung health app is no longer tracking anything, it won't count my steps, it won't sync with other apps, it won't sync with the cloud, anytime I try to fix it myself the settings menu fails to load ANYTHING. It's completely unusable."
            2. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
            3. _Adelaide Powers_, Aug 23, 2026, 3/5: "I was only using the app to track my steps, most of the other stuff is stupid and useless - for me, anyway. Now app has suddenly frozen, won't track steps, can't open it. not sure if I can uninstall and reinstall. please fix. Thank you"
